name: Tha Phae Gate
th: ประตูท่าแพ
notes: All day; peaks 16:00-23:00 and Sunday evening (east end of Sunday Walking Street). Plaza hosts festivals: Songkran (12-15 Apr), Flower Festival parade passes 14 Feb 2026 (Nawarat Bridge -> Tha Phae Gate -> Nong Buak Haad, from ~08:00), Yi Peng/Loy Krathong 23-25 Nov 2026 with lantern releases 18:30-22:30 and 30,000+ people on the peak night (beautiful-chiangmai.com). Main tuk-tuk rank for Old City <-> Night Bazaar/Riverside.
riders: tourists, backpackers, tour groups, locals at events

name: Chang Phueak Gate (North Gate)
th: ประตูช้างเผือก
notes: Evening 17:00-01:00: Chang Phueak night food market + North Gate Jazz Co-op; also daytime traffic to Chang Phueak bus station 500 m north.

name: Suan Dok Gate (West Gate)
th: ประตูสวนดอก
notes: Daytime link between Old City and Suan Dok/Maharaj hospital + Nimman; commuter peaks 07:00-09:00, 16:00-18:00.

name: Saen Pung (Suan Prung) Gate
th: ประตูแสนปุง
notes: Moderate; SW gate near Suan Prung hospital and Nong Buak Haad park; Saturday evening overflow from Wua Lai Walking Street.
riders: locals, hospital visitors, Saturday market visitors

name: Chiang Mai Gate (South Gate)
th: ประตูเชียงใหม่
notes: Two peaks: morning market 04:00-12:00, night food market 17:00-24:00 daily; Saturday evening (north end of Wua Lai Walking Street).

name: Si Phum Corner (NE bastion)
th: แจ่งศรีภูมิ
notes: Landmark pickup point for Moon Muang Soi 6-9 guesthouses and the Ratchawithi bar lane; late-night 23:00-01:00 returns.

name: Hua Lin Corner (NW bastion)
th: แจ่งหัวลิน
notes: Junction toward Huay Kaew Rd / Nimman / Kad Suan Kaew; commuter peaks, student traffic in term time.

name: Ku Hueang Corner (SW bastion)
th: แจ่งกู่เฮือง
notes: Low-moderate; next to Nong Buak Haad park and Suan Prung; early morning/evening joggers.

name: Katam Corner (SE bastion)
th: แจ่งก๊ะต๊ำ
notes: Moderate; junction between Chiang Mai Gate market, Loi Kroh Rd and Night Bazaar.

name: Wat Phra Singh
th: วัดพระสิงห์
notes: 08:00-17:00 daily; huge spike at Songkran (Phra Buddha Sihing procession & bathing, 12-15 Apr). West end of Sunday Walking Street (Sun evening).

name: Wat Chedi Luang
th: วัดเจดีย์หลวงวรวิหาร
notes: 08:00-17:00 (evening chedi visits popular); monk-chat afternoons (unverified); Inthakin city-pillar festival late May (est. 23-29 May 2026), city pillar enshrined here.

name: Wat Chiang Man
th: วัดเชียงมั่น
notes: OSM tag hours 05:00-18:00; the first temple of Chiang Mai, built by King Mangrai in 1297 (Wikipedia); quieter, near Moon Muang backpacker sois.

name: Wat Suan Dok
th: วัดสวนดอก
notes: Daytime + sunset photography; monk chat 17:00-19:00 Mon/Wed/Fri (unverified).

name: Wat Umong (Suan Buddha Dhamma)
th: วัดอุโมงค์(สวนพุทธรรม)
notes: Daytime, forest temple with tunnels; pairs with Baan Kang Wat (Sun morning).

name: Wat Sri Suphan (Silver Temple)
th: วัดศรีสุพรรณ
notes: Daytime + Saturday evening (Wua Lai Walking Street next door); illuminated at night.

name: Wat Lok Molee
th: วัดโลกโมฬี
notes: Daytime; just north of moat, near Hua Lin/Chang Phueak.

name: Wat Phan Tao
th: วัดพันเตา
notes: Daytime; teak viharn beside Wat Chedi Luang; free candle-lit chanting from 19:00 each night of Yi Peng (23-25 Nov 2026, beautiful-chiangmai.com); Visakha Bucha lantern event (May) (unverified).

name: Wat Chet Yot
th: วัดเจ็ดยอด
notes: Daytime; on Superhighway near Maya/Nimman; low foot traffic, good fare distance.

name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
th: วัดพระธาตุดอยสุเทพราชวรวิหาร
notes: 06:00-20:00 daily (OSM tag on way/114651040); morning & sunset peaks; 309 steps from car park, 15 km from city (Wikipedia). Foreigner temple fee 30 THB (unverified). Visakha Bucha (May) overnight walk from Khruba Srivichai Monument, starting ~20:00 (thailandee); ~10,000 walkers (unverified). Mountain road: long uphill fare; most visitors use red songthaew from CMU/zoo (unverified).

name: Wat Pha Lat
th: วัดผาลาด
notes: Daytime; mid-mountain on Monk's Trail; hikers start behind CMU.

name: Wat Buppharam
th: วัดบุพพาราม
notes: Daytime on Tha Phae Rd between gate and river.

name: Wat Phan On
th: วัดพันอ้น
notes: Sunday evening food court inside temple grounds during Sunday Walking Street.

name: Wat Phra That Doi Kham
th: วัดพระธาตุดอยคำ
notes: Weekend & holiday peaks; lottery-luck temple; SW near Royal Park Rajapruek/Night Safari.

name: Three Kings Monument
th: อนุสาวรีย์สามกษัตริย์
notes: Daytime; ceremonies/offerings; center of Old City museum cluster; Yi Peng cultural fair and Krathong Yai parade staging area (23-25 Nov 2026, beautiful-chiangmai.com).

name: Chiang Mai City Arts & Cultural Centre
th: หอศิลปวัฒนธรรมเมืองเชียงใหม่
notes: Wed-Sun 08:30-16:30 incl. public holidays, closed Mon-Tue (cmocity.com, 2026); behind Three Kings Monument.

name: Lanna Folklife Museum
th: พิพิธภัณฑ์พื้นถิ่นล้านนา
notes: Wed-Sun 08:30-16:30 incl. public holidays, closed Mon-Tue (cmocity.com, 2026).

name: Chiang Mai National Museum
th: พิพิธภัณฑ์แห่งชาติ จังหวัดเชียงใหม่
notes: Wed-Sun 09:00-16:00 per OSM tag on way/200414775 (not checked against Fine Arts Dept site: unverified); on Superhighway near Wat Chet Yot.

name: Baan Kang Wat Artist Village
th: บ้านข้างวัด
notes: Daytime Tue-Sun; Sunday morning market (unverified); next to Wat Umong.

name: Old Chiang Mai Cultural Center (khantoke)
th: ศูนย์วัฒนธรรมเชียงใหม่
notes: Evening 19:00-22:00 khantoke dinner shows (unverified); hotel pickups.

name: Warorot Market (Kad Luang)
th: ตลาดวโรรส
notes: 06:00-19:00 daily per ChiangMaiTravelHub (403 on re-check), 07:00-18:00 per OSM tag on way/89039067 (conflict); busiest mornings & weekends; pre-festival shopping peaks (unverified). Songthaew hub on Chang Moi/Wichayanon Rd.

name: Ton Lamyai Market & Flower Market
th: ตลาดต้นลำไย
notes: Flower market nominally open 24/7, many stalls close off-peak; best early morning when deliveries arrive (catisoutoftheoffice). OSM tag on the market building: 05:00-18:00. Next to Warorot.

name: Chiang Mai Night Bazaar
notes: Daily ~17:00/18:00-24:00, busiest 19:00-22:00; tuk-tuk rank on Chang Klan Rd (unverified); high season Nov-Feb (unverified).

name: Anusarn Market
th: ตลาดอนุสาร
notes: Evening daily; seafood, cabaret, Anusarn boxing; overlaps Night Bazaar.

name: Kalare Night Bazaar
notes: Evening; operating status uncertain (Kalare boxing page shows closed, Oct 2025) (unverified).

name: Somphet Market
th: ตลาดสมเพชร
notes: 05:00-19:00 daily per web guide, 06:00-16:00 per OSM tag; morning cooking-school market tours from Moon Muang guesthouses.

name: Chiang Mai Gate Market
th: ตลาดประตูเชียงใหม่
notes: 04:00-12:00 fresh market; 17:00-24:00 night food market, daily (twoticketsanywhere, updated Jun 2026; OSM tag says Th-Mo 07:00-22:00, conflict). Stalls line both sides of Bumrung Buri Rd; night food stalls mapped at node/4430138378. Saturday walking-street overflow.

name: Chang Phueak Night Market
th: ตลาดช้างเผือก
notes: Evening 17:00-late; famous khao kha moo stall; outside North Gate.

name: Muang Mai Market
th: ตลาดเมืองใหม่
notes: Largest wholesale fruit/veg market; open daily 06:00-19:00, most vendors close at night, arrive early for the freshest produce (catisoutoftheoffice, updated Nov 2024). Pre-dawn wholesale window (unverified). Cargo-heavy trips (vendors with goods).

name: Jing Jai (JJ) Farmers Market
notes: Sat-Sun 06:30-15:00 (jontotheworld; other sources say 14:00 close); best 07:30-10:30 (same source).

name: Kham Thiang Flower & Plant Market
th: ตลาดคำเที่ยง
notes: Daytime, weekend peak; plants = bulky cargo trips.

name: Sunday Walking Street (Ratchadamnoen Rd)
th: ถนนคนเดินวันอาทิตย์
notes: Sunday 17:00-23:00; crowds peak 19:00-21:00 (chiangmaiambassador 2026); road closed to traffic, pick up at Tha Phae Gate or side sois. Biggest single weekly demand spike.

name: Saturday Walking Street (Wua Lai Rd)
th: ถนนคนเดินวัวลาย
notes: Saturday 17:00-23:00; crowds peak 19:00-21:00 (chiangmaiambassador 2026); road closed; pick up at Chiang Mai Gate / Thiphanet Rd.

name: Kad Na Mor (CMU Front Gate Market)
th: กาดหน้ามอ
notes: Daily 17:00-22:00, busiest after 18:30 when classes end (chiangmaimaster); term-time peak; student budget fares.

name: University Gate Food Market (Lang Mor)
notes: Daily evenings; CMU back (engineering) gate area; term-time peak.

name: Central Chiangmai Airport (Central Plaza Airport)
th: เซ็นทรัลพลาซ่า เชียงใหม่ แอร์พอร์ต
notes: Mall hours per OSM tag Mo-Fr 11:00-21:00, Sa-Su 10:00-21:00 (unverified on mall site); weekend peaks; 0.76 km straight-line from the CNX terminal building. Brand renamed from CentralPlaza Chiang Mai Airport to Central Chiangmai Airport in early 2022 (Wikipedia).

name: Central Festival Chiangmai
th: เซ็นทรัล เฟสติวัล เชียงใหม่
notes: Hours per OSM tag Mo-Th 11:00-21:30, Fr 11:00-22:00, Sa-Su 10:00-22:00 (unverified on mall site); opened 15 Nov 2013, 250,000 m2 (Central Pattana); CPN page slug is "central-chiangmai", so current brand may be "Central Chiangmai" (unverified). Superhighway NE near Arcade bus terminal.

name: Promenada Resort Mall
notes: Daytime/evening, weekends; far east (San Kamphaeng side) = long fares.

name: MAYA Lifestyle Shopping Center
th: เมญ่า
notes: 11:00-22:00 (unverified); rooftop bar evenings; Nimman/Rincome junction.

name: One Nimman
notes: Daytime + evening; weekend market; Nimman soi 1 end.

name: Think Park
notes: Evening pop-up market/events; opposite Maya.

name: Kad Suan Kaew (Central Kad Suan Kaew)
th: กาดสวนแก้ว
notes: CLOSED: the shopping centre ended public operation 30 Jun 2022 and was advertised for sale (3 bn THB) in Sep 2024 (Wikipedia "Kad Suan Kaew"). OSM still maps the dept-store node; the building relation/6091082 is now named "12 Huay Kaew Complex" (current use unverified). Treat as a landmark with near-zero demand unless reopened.

name: Chiang Mai International Airport (CNX) terminal
th: ท่าอากาศยานนานาชาติเชียงใหม่
notes: ~05:00-24:00 flights; peaks around morning & evening banks; high season Nov-Feb & Songkran (unverified). 9.52 M passengers in 2025. Tuk-tuks drop at departures; arrivals use official taxi/app queue (unverified).

name: Chiang Mai Railway Station
th: เชียงใหม่
notes: Arrivals cluster early morning (overnight trains from Bangkok) and evening departures (unverified); east of river = long fare to Old City.

name: Arcade Bus Terminal 2
th: สถานีขนส่ง อาเขต (หมายเลข 2)
notes: All day + overnight VIP buses to/from Bangkok; long-distance north/northeast; spikes before/after long weekends and Songkran.

name: Arcade Bus Terminal 3
th: สถานีขนส่ง อาเขต (หมายเลข 3)
notes: Long-distance buses; adjacent to Terminal 2 (~150 m).

name: Chang Phueak Bus Station (Terminal 1)
th: สถานีขนส่งช้างเผือก
notes: Provincial buses to Mae Rim, Chiang Dao, Fang, Tha Ton, Phrao, Hot, Chom Thong, Samoeng; mornings busiest (unverified); yellow songthaew stands next door.

name: Chiang Mai University Main Gate
th: ประตูหน้า มช.
notes: Term-time (unverified months) weekdays 07:00-09:00 & 16:00-18:00, nightly Kad Na Mor; 38,269 students (2023).

name: Chiang Mai Rajabhat University
th: มหาวิทยาลัยราชภัฏเชียงใหม่
notes: Term-time weekday peaks; near Chang Phueak.

name: Maharaj Nakorn Chiang Mai Hospital (CMU Suan Dok)
th: โรงพยาบาลมหาราชนครเชียงใหม่
notes: Weekday morning OPD heaviest (unverified); 24h ER; 1,400 beds.

name: Chiang Mai Ram Hospital
th: โรงพยาบาลเชียงใหม่ราม
notes: Daytime weekdays; private hospital on Boonruangrit Rd.

name: Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai
th: โรงพยาบาลกรุงเทพ
notes: Daytime; far east on Superhighway = long fares.

name: Iron Bridge (Khua Lek)
th: ขัวเหล็ก
notes: Evening photos; Yi Peng/Loy Krathong 23-25 Nov 2026: krathong floating on the Ping between Nawarat Bridge and Iron Bridge (beautiful-chiangmai.com); at Loi Kroh Rd river end.

name: Nawarat Bridge
th: สะพานนวรัฐ
notes: Main Tha Phae Rd river crossing; Flower Festival parade start 14 Feb 2026 (~08:00); Yi Peng/Loy Krathong krathong-floating stretch runs from here to Iron Bridge (23-25 Nov 2026).

name: The Riverside Bar & Restaurant
notes: OSM opening_hours Mon-Sun 17:00-01:00; live music, dinner cruises (unverified).

name: Good View
th: เดอะกู้ดวิว เชียงใหม่
notes: Evening, live bands; next to The Riverside on Charoenrat Rd.

name: Zoe in Yellow / Ratchawithi bar lane
notes: Nightly ~20:00-24:00/01:00 close; 23:30-01:30 exodus to guesthouses.

name: North Gate Jazz Co-op
notes: OSM opening_hours Mo-Su 20:00-02:00; jam nights (unverified).

name: Loi Kroh Road bar strip
th: ถนนลอยเคราะห์
notes: Nightly 19:00-02:00; between Kotchasarn Rd and Chang Klan Rd.

name: Thapae Boxing Stadium
notes: Mon-Sat, doors 20:00, fights from 21:00 (chiangmaiboxingstadiums.com); ~7 bouts and ~23:30 finish (unverified).

name: Loi Kroh Boxing Stadium
notes: Fights Mon/Wed/Fri 21:00-24:00, closed other nights (occasional Tue/Thu events); tickets 600 THB standard / 1,000 THB ringside (muaythaichiangmai.com). Inside Loi Kroh bar complex.

name: Warm Up Cafe (Nimman)
notes: Nightly club ~21:00-02:00; weekend peak; Nimman soi area.

name: Chiang Mai Zoo (main entrance)
th: สวนสัตว์เชียงใหม่
notes: Hours conflict: 08:00-17:00 (ChiangMaiTravelHub, 403 on re-check) vs 09:00-17:00 (Wikivoyage); official chiangmaizoo.com unreachable (TLS error) - (unverified). Wikivoyage fees: adult 350 THB / child 120. Weekends/school holidays peak (unverified); Huay Kaew Rd at foot of Doi Suthep.

name: Huay Kaew Waterfall
th: น้ำตกห้วยแก้ว
notes: Afternoons & weekends; Doi Suthep-Pui national-park fee since 1 Oct 2025 (foreign adult 100 THB, Thai adult 20 THB).

name: Khruba Srivichai Monument
th: อนุสาวรีย์ครูบาศรีวิชัย
notes: Start of Doi Suthep road; songthaew transfer point (unverified); Visakha Bucha walk starts here ~20:00 (thailandee; ~10,000 walkers unverified).

name: Ang Kaew Reservoir (CMU)
th: อ่างแก้ว
notes: Early morning & late afternoon; inside CMU campus.

name: Chiang Mai Night Safari
th: เชียงใหม่ไนท์ซาฟารี
notes: Ticket booth 11:00-21:00, closes 22:00; Safari Tram foreign adult 1,200 THB / Thai adult 300; Jaguar Trail walk foreign 400 / Thai 50 (chiangmainightsafari.com, 2026). Site advises arriving ~17:00; return trips 20:00-22:00. Pickup = OSM entrance=main node/1075186977 inside zoo polygon way/250585255. SW edge (Hang Dong side) = long fares.

name: Royal Park Rajapruek
th: อุทยานหลวงราชพฤกษ์
notes: 08:00-18:00 daily; foreign adult 200 THB / child 150, Thai adult 100 / child 70 (royalparkrajapruek.org/Admission, read 2026-09-26); cool-season peak Dec-Feb (unverified). Pickup = OSM main entrance node/1561123863 inside park polygon way/186782433 ("Royal Flora Ratchaphruek Park"). Next to Night Safari.

name: Huay Tung Tao Lake
th: ทะเลสาบห้วยตึงเฒ่า
notes: Weekends & holidays; hours 08:00-18:00 per OSM tag on relation/9227296, 08:00-20:00 per Holidify (conflict); entry 50 THB (Holidify, no Thai/foreign split; a 20 THB Thai rate is unverified). Point is the lake centroid (in the water): snap to the lakeside road. Lakeside bamboo huts; N of city (Mae Rim).

name: Nong Buak Haad Public Park
th: สวนบวกหาด
notes: 06:00-08:00 & 16:00-19:00 (unverified); OSM tag hours 05:00-21:00; Chiang Mai Flower Festival site (13-15 Feb 2026; parade from ~08:00 finishes here 14 Feb).

name: Chiang Mai Grand Canyon (water park)
th: แกรนด์แคนยอน เชียงใหม่
notes: Daytime; hot-season Mar-May peak (unverified); far SW (Hang Dong) = long fare.

name: Bhubing Palace
th: พระตำหนักภูพิงคราชนิเวศน์
notes: Daytime; closed when royals in residence (unverified); beyond Doi Suthep (songthaew territory).

name: 700th Anniversary Stadium
th: สนามกีฬาสมโภชเชียงใหม่ 700 ปี
notes: Match nights and concerts (unverified); big one-off spikes.

name: Moon Muang Soi 6-9 backpacker area
th: ถนนมูลเมือง ซอย 7
notes: Mornings (tours/cooking classes/transfers 07:00-09:00), evenings to markets, late-night returns from bars.

name: Nimmanhaemin Soi 7-9 hotel & cafe area
th: ถนนนิมมานเหมินท์ ซอย 7
notes: Daytime cafe hopping, evening nightlife; U Nimman / Art Mai hotels nearby.
riders: digital nomads, Thai & Chinese tourists, students

name: 137 Pillars House
notes: Hotel transfers, dinner trips to Night Bazaar/Old City; east riverside (Wat Ket).

name: Anantara Chiang Mai Resort
notes: Riverside on Charoenprathet Rd; evening trips to Night Bazaar (~0.4 km).

name: Shangri-La Chiang Mai
notes: Chang Klan Rd; Night Bazaar walkable; airport transfers.

name: Tamarind Village
notes: Old City, Ratchadamnoen Rd; on Sunday Walking Street.

name: Bo Sang Umbrella Village
th: บ่อสร้าง
notes: Painted-umbrella village ~10 km east of Tha Phae Gate in San Kamphaeng; the Bo Sang Umbrella & San Kamphaeng Handicraft Festival fills it in mid/late January (calendar.md §4).
